acceptance: Unsigned or unapproved-key tags are refused (tested with a throwaway pre-release tag on TestPyPI path)
Artifact hash mismatch or missing queue run refuses publish (tested)
pypi environment reviewers unchanged; test-pypi used for rehearsal
context: codex C3/C7, muse M6/M8, earlier-round C3. Artifact retention must cover the time between queue run and tag (set retention >= 90 days or re-upload to release storage).
description:
New release workflow (release-v2.yml until dlv2-53 renames/replaces release.yml) on push of tags v*:
1. Verify the tag is annotated and signed by an approved key (keys listed in repo); refuse otherwise.
2. Resolve the tag commit; require it is on develop and has a successful merge_group ci.yml run; download that run's wheel+sdist; verify sha256 equals the recorded hashes (no rebuild).
3. T4: install+smoke on Python 3.11-3.14 x Linux/macOS/Windows (cross-OS correctness claims only after dlv2-defer-tpch-digest-darwin-arm64), UAT release-gate configs (tests/uat/configs/release-gate-*.yaml), _binaries hash manifest check, make release-check (dlv2-50), ruleset drift (D7), no open release-blocking t3:* issue.
4. Attest artifacts; publish via environment pypi (required reviewers kept; OIDC); GitHub release with notes.
Legacy release.yml keeps working in parallel until dlv2-53 (G7).
